title: Effects of tapering on performance in endurance athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
claims: The meta-analysis included 14 studies and found significant improvements in time-trial and time-to-exhaustion performance after tapering.
A taper that reduced training volume by 41-60%, maintained training intensity and frequency, and lasted up to 21 days was associated with improved time-trial performance.
Tapering combined with pre-taper overload training showed a larger effect on time-trial performance than conventional tapering.
The authors note that tapering practices still need individual adaptation.
